textbookText: **Stoichiometry:** n = m/M · 1 mol = 6.022×10²¹ particles · V(STP)=22.4 L · %comp = (mass of element / molar mass of compound)×100 · limiting reagent = smallest (molesₗ / coefficient). **Atomic:** rₙ = n² · a₀/Z · Eₙ = −13.6 eV · (n/Z)² · mvr = nh/2π · ionisation of H = 13.6 eV · # spectral lines from n → 1 = n(n−1)/2. **Gas laws:** PV=nRT · PV/T = const · P₁V₁=P₂V₂ · V₁/T₁=V₂/T₂ · P₁/T₁=P₂/T₂ · Dalton: P₅ = Pₘ₀ + Pₘ₁ · rₘ/rₙ = √(Mₙ/Mₘ) · M = 2 × vapor density. **Kinetic:** KE_avg = ¾ kT · P = ⅛ ρ c̅² · PV = N·¾ kT̅ · v_rms > v_avg > v_mp.
